subject: Heartland (2026 film)
query: who is in the cast of heartland
title: Who is in the cast of Heartland on Netflix? Jessica Chastain leads
answer: Netflix's Heartland stars Jessica Chastain as Misty Jones, a retired country music star who comes out of seclusion to search for her missing niece. The cast also includes Garrett Hedlund, country singer Carter Faith, Ross Lynch, Jennifer Nettles and John Hawkes. The thriller streams on Netflix worldwide from Nov. 13, 2026.
body:
Shana Feste, the writer-director of "Country Strong," directed and co-wrote the film. Netflix lists these roles: Jessica Chastain as Misty Jones, Garrett Hedlund as Roy Combs, Carter Faith as Charlie Heart, Ross Lynch as Jace, Jennifer Nettles as Winnie Jo Lean, John Hawkes as Clark and Skyler Day as Lea Heart. Ben Dickey, Isabelle Kusman, Wynn Everett, Paul Sparks, David Rysdahl, Hill Harper and Norbert Leo Butz also appear.

The story is set in Nashville. Misty's search for her niece, a rising country musician, leads her into the city's darker side and forces her to confront her own past. Netflix lists the running time as 1 hour 54 minutes. Peter Chernin and Jenno Topping of Chernin Entertainment are among the producers.

Two of the actors are working country artists: Jennifer Nettles is the singer of Sugarland, and Carter Faith, who plays Charlie Heart, is a 2026 CMA Awards nominee for New Artist of the Year.
in_the_news: Heartland premieres on Netflix on Friday, Nov. 13, 2026.
